statements.text: According to G.O.Ms.No.27, works costing above Rs.1.00 crore, including emergency works, can be sanctioned by the Government only.
According to Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, the Commissioner, Urban Services, may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
statements.quote: administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.

statements.text: A note file dated 24/09/2026 states that the Commissioner may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
statements.quote: may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
